route: Full-lattice NA with GROW size-bounded relevance set Q for factor designs with p/log n -> inf
why_failed: Start mode tends to all of [p], |Q|~p violates GROW's log size bound; whole-lattice NA fails on one-sided sets once log p/log n > 1/6 (Prop SHARP).

route: Charging only log n for the add-statistic budget (no BB prior ratio)
why_failed: Gives exponent 1/8 for kappa=1; exact BB ratio essential to reach 1/6.

route: Scalar residual-factor step for k >= 2 global factors
why_failed: Does not extend; matrix version needs a loading condition on T-restricted Grams (conjectural obstruction, not proved).

route: Genericity (GC-CS) at a = 1/2 with study patterns
why_failed: A truth with zero marginal signal ((1-a)θ_j+aΘ=0) violates (GC-CS); not covered (later handled in W2-FAC-B C1-M).

route: p > K (start mode capped at K) under the lattice/path route
why_failed: Swap phase longer than MR1 slack conceivable; untested at asymptotic sizes (heuristic only).

route: v1 statement: log-n margin for swaps in (C2)(iii)
why_failed: False: analytic O_P(1) counterexample; only 'swaps strictly below chosen deletion' claimed (v1 REJECTED at R01).

route: Whole-lattice NA (FAC-A route) on exact-Gram CS for p>>log n
why_failed: Whole-lattice NA is false here; analysis must be path-restricted.

route: GROW O(log n) relevance-set route
why_failed: Start mode is the whole model (order-n signal per null block); no O(log n) relevance set; LS0 cap must be >~|S̃0|.

route: Legacy LS0 cap l_n on CS
why_failed: Start is whole model, LS0 needs m0=p-s0-|N0| moves; legacy cap misses S0 when m0 >= l_n+2.

route: Extend FAC-CS to p > n/2
why_failed: Saturated start; swaps gain ~M(τin²-τout²) vs deletions ~½log n; N2 (n=600,p=500): 19 swaps+296 deletions=315 > MR1 cap 311, LS0 misses S0. Not proved.

route: Extend L1/L4 to S5 / block CS
why_failed: 1-D reduction lost: group-level centre and within-group jumps break the gap invariant; needs two-level invariant (crude bound suggests log p/log n <~ 1/3 for S5).

route: General one-factor loadings / k>=2
why_failed: Variable-specific centres make retained set history-dependent in a band; naive bootstrap of |x_T| loses a log n factor.

route: iid rows for CS
why_failed: Sample Gram not exactly CS (||R^-Sigma||~sqrt(p/n)); exact reduction only up to perturbation entering via the band.

route: v1 dynamic (path-restricted) proof route for (P3)
why_failed: Replaced by a static route (weaker hypotheses, claims less path structure); v1 REJECTED at R01.

route: Merged LS0 cap l_n+|S̃0| (and legacy l_n) for CS with p>K
why_failed: Checked asymptotic counterexample (NEG): polynomially many initial swaps exceed O(log n) slack; any allowance <=n^β, β<1/2, fails.

route: G2 uniform residual floor for p >> n
why_failed: Not a consequence of Gaussian noise alone: fixed design p=Kn<=n² (R08) with data-selected size-K model RSS_T/n->0; extra model-count hypothesis needed.

route: Settle p >> n (F1) / NEG for K<p<=16K/15 (F2)
why_failed: Not proved; only heuristic that NEG mechanism persists; PATH needs p>=K+16s0+1.

route: Uniform-partition counterexample to LS0 (T2 negative branch)
why_failed: Singleton partition is explicitly nonproduction; an arbitrary-partition counterexample refutes only the uniform-partition claim, nothing on the production linkage partition.

route: Fixed-factor structure and truth non-masking alone as input for null visibility/saturation
why_failed: They do not supply null visibility; saturation needs small-set concentration, eigenvalue floor, nonzero conditional exposure, enough visible nulls.

route: Inheriting FAC-B (P), full start S*, L3 E2 residual lower bound, L4.0(d) for p>n/2
why_failed: Not inherited: residual lower bound fails beyond p<=n/2; at p=n-1 the residual chi-square is zero; no retained-null sign symmetry.
